in_arabic.name: Nisbi
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Possessor or owner
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nisbi هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-b', meaning 'to possess' or 'to own'. In Islamic context, this name can symbolize one's connection to Allah and the belief that all blessings come from Him.
